Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run-chase! The Indian players are in the huddle and they disperse now to take their respective positions. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney are the openers for Australia Women. Renuka Singh to start with the ball for India Women. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Australia Women would be pretty disappointed with this bowling effort. They pulled things back a bit in the middle overs after India got off to a quick start with Ellyse Perry getting rid of Shafali Verma and Jemimah Rodrigues in quick succession. Annabel Sutherland and Alana King bowled decently in the middle overs along with Ashleigh Gardner but there was always a boundary ball in between which the Indian batters made sure to take full advantage of. However, India smashed 57 in the last five overs which included 18 off the last over from the experienced Megan Schutt and now it is up to the Australian batters to win them this game. Let's see how they go about their business in this run-chase.

The Indian skipper Harmanpreet Kaur has emphasised time and again in the recent past that they want to play an aggressive brand of cricket which is exactly what we saw from Indian batters today.  Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana came out all guns blazing in the Powerplay and by the time Verma departed on 21 off just 10 balls, the pressure was on Australia. However, Jemimah Rodrigues departed for a duck and Smriti Mandhana who played a quick eye-catching knock departed in the 8th over. Kaur and Devika Vaidya then steadied the ship but India lost their skipper just when she was trying to explode. However, young Richa Ghosh came out with great intent and played a brilliant cameo of 36 off just 20 balls and Deepti Sharma then carried that momentum as she smashed 36 off just 15 deliveries to take India to a huge total here.

A brilliant batting display from India! Take a bow, Deepti Sharma! She has played a blinder here to take India over 170. India will be pretty happy with this score but the pitch is quite good to bat on and Australia have a dangerous batting line-up. However, India will surely go into the break as a happier side.

Megan Schutt does get it full enough this time around. This is around the legs and Deepti Sharma brooms it behind square on the leg side for a single. 18 off the over and India Women finish with 172/5 on the board!

FOUR! This is just poor bowling from an experienced campaigner. Pace on this time, fuller and once again down leg. Deepti Sharma whips it away into the fine leg fence to make it four boundaries on the trot.

FOUR! A hat-trick of boundaries from Deepti Sharma and the crowd is going completely wild. This is fuller and down leg, Sharma gets low and just scoops it fine. The ball beats the fielder at fine leg and goes into the fence.

FOUR! This is a scintillating cameo from Deepti Sharma. back of a length and angling into the body. Sharma comes down the track and pulls it wide of the fielder at deep backward square leg for another boundary.

FOUR! In the gap! Slower one from around the wicket and dug in short. Deepti Sharma comes forward and pulls it in between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg. The fielders over there look at each other as the ball runs away into the fence.
Devika Vaidya advances and Megan Schutt just bowls it shorter and wider of the off stump. Vaidya is able to reach it and hits it through covers for a single.
This is angled into the pads, Devika Vaidya heaves it aerially and towards cow corner but just for a single.
Gardner sees Sharma coming this time and pulls the length back. This is heaved away through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Hammered away and the 150 is now up for India Women. Tossed up around middle, Deepti Sharma dances down the track and drills it back past the bowler to make it back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Poor delivery, begging to be hit. Another juicy full toss on leg stump, Deepti Sharma steps out and pulls it down to the square leg fence for a boundary.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and tosses it outside off. Devika Vaidya steps out and hits it wide of mid off for a quick single.
This is a full toss down the leg side, Deepti Sharma paddles it towards fine leg for only a single.
Slower one, full and around middle, this is flicked away in front of mid-wicket for a single. Can India Women get to the 160-run mark from here?
FOUR! Top shot! Short but not that wide, Deepti Sharma stays on the back foot and pounces on it. Sharma cuts it hard and past the point fielder for yet another boundary.
Goes full and straight now, taking pace off as well, Sharma just eases it towards mid off.
FOUR! Nicely done! Just short of a length and on leg stump, Deepti Sharma swivels and pulls it fine, beating the diving fielder at fine leg to pick up a boundary.
Beaten! Good length, closer to the off stump and slanting across. Deepti Sharma looks to hang back and just guide it late but is well beaten.
Sutherland starts the new spell with a length ball angling across off stump. Devika Vaidya hits it on the up and through covers for a single.
Floated up around the legs, Deepti Sharma paddles it down to short fine leg.
Deepti Sharma walks out to the middle now.

OUT! STUMPED! Ashleigh Gardner has the last laugh here and picks up a vital scalp for her team. Gardner bowls it quicker and very full and pushes it well wide of the off stump. Richa Ghosh advances a long way down the track and is just completely outsmarted by the bowler. Ghosh tries to reach for it but misses and Alyssa Healy takes off the bails in a flash. Ghosh starts walking but it is sent upstairs. The replay confirm that Ghosh was well out of her crease but it was still solid cameo from her.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: This is very full again and around off, Ghosh squeezes it out towards point.
Lovely comeback from Ashleigh Gardner! This is speared in full and around off, Ghosh looks to shuffle but gets yorked and misses the ball.
SIX! High and handsome! This is a flighted delivery on middle, Richa Ghosh dances down the track and whacks it right back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Tossed up around middle, Devika Vaidya uses her feet and pushes it down to long off for one.
Richa Ghosh is looing in great touch here! Can she power India over 170 here?
Slower one, on a length and outside off. Devika Vaidya drags this one through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and angling into leg stump, Ghosh backs away and heaves it down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Edgy boundary but Richa Ghosh won't mind at all. Schutt goes pace on this time and serves it on a hard length around off, Ghosh throws the kitchen sink at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies over short third man for a boundary.
WIDE! This is full and wide but spilled beyond the tramline outside off.
Good length, around middle and leg, this is worked away onto the onside for a run.

A slight misfield and they get an extra run. This is banged in short and around middle, Devika Vaidya pulls it towards deep mid-wicket where Annabel Sutherland fumbles and the batters pick up a couple of runs.
Starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, pace off and angling across. Devika Vaidya waits for it and eases it towards cover-point.
Megan Schutt (2-0-15-0) is back on for her third spell.
Pushes it quicker and flatter on off. Ghosh pushes it back to the bowler. 12 from the over!
Tossed up delivery on middle. Ghosh blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and wide outside off. Ghosh picks the length quickly, gets into the position early and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on middle. Devika Vaidya works it to the leg side for a single.
SIX! Devika Vaidya joins the act now! Tossed up on off. Vaidya skips down the track and slogs it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fires a flatter delivery on off. Ghosh tries to push it but gets an inside edge that goes past the stumps for a single.
Tossed up again on off. Vaidya sweeps it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Tossed up on leg. Ghosh works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Wow! What a lovely shot! Touch shorter and around off. Ghosh waits for it and just opens her bat face at the last moment to guide it through the gully region for a boundary.
FOUR! Finds the gap perfectly this time! Short and on off. Ghosh picks the length quickly and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! Richa Ghosh is a talented young cricketer and she has shown every bit of her talent in this shot! Tossed up, on off. Ghosh gets low and slogs it down the ground for a maximum.
Tossed up, around off. Vaidya slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cuts it firmly and finds the gap! Short and on off. Ghosh goes deep in her crease and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Flatter and touch shorter, around off. Ghosh dabs it towards the off side.
A fuller delivery on middle. Vaidya clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Angles a quicker delivery on leg. Vaidya tries to clip it but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but nothing serious.
A flatter delivery angling into off. Ghosh tries to drive it but gets the inside edge onto her pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and a single is taken.
Jess Jonassen starts with a tossed-up delivery, on off. Ghosh tries to drive it but the ball goes off the inside half of her blade to mid on.
On a length and around off. Vaidya drives it on the up bit uppishly but well short of the cover fielder.
FOUR! Nice shot! Touch shorter and outside off. Vaidya punches it firmly past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Lands it on a length on middle. It nips back in and Ghosh misses her clip as the ball deflects off her pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
On a length, on middle. Ghosh blocks it back to the bowler.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kim Garth strikes on her Australian debut! Harmanpreet Kaur departs and she will be very disappointed. She was looking quite set and ready to explode. This is a fullish delivery, outside off. Kaur tries to hit it over the extra cover fielder but fails to get the elevation and ends up hitting it straight to Annabel Sutherland who is stationed in the ring at the extra cover position. Big wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Kim Garth

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls a full delivery on off. She gets a good shape away from the batter and Kaur defends it calmly.
King bowls it short and on middle. Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated up on middle. Devika Vaidya works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes it quicker and flatter, around off. Kaur tries to drive it but gets an inside edge that goes towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Gives the charge again and swipes this full delivery on middle to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another tossed up delivery, around off. Vaidya skips down the track and drives it to covers.
King tosses this up on middle. Kaur drives it to long on and takes a single.
This is fuller and pushed a bit more across the left-hander. Devika Vaidya looks to drive away from the body but is beaten on the outside edge.
Nagging length and on off stump, Kaur watchfully just nudges it towards short cover and scampers through for a quick single. Good running there.
FOUR! Muscled away! Short of a length but just not short enough. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it off the front foot and into the vacant square leg fence for a boundary.
Pitches it up now around off, Kaur leans forward and drives it straight towards cover.
WIDE! An attempted slower ball but it is spilled down the leg side for a wide.

Full again, on middle and leg, Kaur clips it away wide of mid on and picks up a couple of runs with ease. The ball almost went into the fence but the fielder from long on made a brilliant diving effort.
Full and on off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it firmly back to the bowler who makes a half stop before the ball goes towards mid off.
King pushes this one through quicker and bowls it flatter as well. Devika Vaidya blocks it off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, Kaur drives it through mid off and just rotates the strike.
A bit quicker and flatter in line with the stumps, Kaur hops back and punches it out on the off side.
Shortens the length now and bowls it around middle, Devika Vaidya works it away towards mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! This is floated up down the leg side, Vaidya misses the sweep and a wide is called.
Tossed up around off stump, Devika Vaidya defends it off the front foot.
Alana King starts off with a floated delivery around the pads. kaur nudges it on the leg side for a quick single.
Devika Vaidya walks out at number 5! Also, Alana King is into the attack now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Annabel Sutherland strikes in her first over and it is a huge wicket for Australia Women. This is served on a good length and angled across the left-hander. Smriti Mandhana hangs on the back foot and just looks to punch it on the up. Mandhana ends up playing a checked-drive and the ball goes towards point where Beth Mooney takes a good low catch. The front foot is checked by the third umpire but Sutherland has something behind the line and Mandhana has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Annabel Sutherland

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs it in this time and angles it at the body. Harmanpreet Kaur gets rushed on as she pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
This is full and wide, Kaur backs away a bit and has to really reach for it. Kaur though is unable to get to the ball.

A bit of intent from Smriti Mandhana but once again the timing just isn't quite there. This is on a length and around off, Mandhana charges down the track and lifts it on the bounce to the fielder at deep point for a single.
Jaffa! This is a beauty from Sutherland as she serves it on a good length and on a tighter line around off stump. The ball seams away from the left-hander and leaves Mandhana bamboozled.
Annabel Sutherland starts off with a very full delivery on middle and leg, Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it away through mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Annabel Sutherland is into the attack now.
Missed opportunity! Gardner comes from around the wicket and serves a juicy full toss on middle and leg, Smriti Mandhana opts to just pat it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Kaur knocks it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Driven and driven nicely. This is a half-volley outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur leans on and drives it past Tahlia McGrath at extra cover for a boundary.
Just milking the singles here. Full and around off, driven along the turf towards sweeper cover for a single.
This is floated up well outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur reaches out and drives it square on the off side for one more.
Gardner starts off with a tossed-up delivery, this is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana strokes it through covers for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner is into the attack now.
This is full and around the pads, Smriti Mandhana drives it in front of mid-wicket and picks up a single. At the end of the Powerplay, India Women are 48/2!
Drop and run! Slower one, on a length and around off, Kaur just bunts it out with soft hands on the off side and scampers through for a run.
Nicely bowled! Good length around off and this one nips back in off the deck. Kaur is a bit late on the block but manages to keep it out.
Schutt goes a bit wider of the crease and angles it in from outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it off the front foot.

Uppish but safe! This is pitched up around off, Smriti Mandhana looks to drive on the up but the ball comes off the outer half of the bat and just goes past the diving fielder at point. The batters pick up a single.
Schutt serves a yorker-length delivery around off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive but edges it down towards short third man.
Megan Schutt (1-0-12-0) is back on.
A wicket-maiden from Ellyse Perry! A back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Kaur dabs it towards the off side calmly.
Harmanpreet Kaur, the Indian skipper walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ellyse Perry gets her second wicket and Jemimah Rodrigues departs for a duck. The pressure was building with four dot balls in a row and Perry very clevery goes wide of the crease and angles a short delivery on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues goes for a pull shot again and this time she gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air and toward mid on where Annabel Sutherland takes an easy catch. So, Indian are scoring quickly but they have lost two wickets in the Powerplay now.
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Ellyse Perry

Commentary.Commentary: An effort delivery this time. A short one around leg. Jemimah Rodrigues tries to pull it but misses.
Angles a length delivery on middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues works it towards the leg side.
Beaten! On a good length and around off again. The ball seams away a bit and beats Jemimah Rodrigues as she tries to punch it towards the off side.
On a good length and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues punches it to the point fielder.

FOUR! Finds the gap this time and it is the fourth boundary of this over! Garth continues to bowl touch short and provides the width as well. Smriti Mandhana plays a delightful cut shot through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Garth keeps the length short and Smriti Mandhana chops it away towards the off side.
Back of a length and outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it towards the cover point fielder.

FOUR! Three in a row now and this time Smriti Mandhana gets a bit lucky. On the shorter side and around off. Smriti Mandhana tries to punch it but gets an inside edge that runs past the stumps for a boundary.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is on a roll here! Garth bowls it short and on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it aerially towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary!
FOUR! In the air...but in the gap! Short of good length and around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it aerially but it is in the gap through cover-point for a boundary.
WIDE! Short and way outside off this. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Back of a length, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it from her crease.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ellyse Perry strikes and gets rid of the dangerous Shafali Verma! Perry bowls it just short of good length and angles it around leg. Verma tries to pull it but only manages to tuck it left of the kepeer. Alyssa Healy there dives full length and takes a superb catch to send the Indian opener back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Ellyse Perry

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! What a shot! Back of a length and outside off. Verma cuts it uppishly and all the way over the point fence for a maximum.

FOUR! Luck favours the brave and this time Shafali is that brave girl! Short and around off. Verma tries to cut it but gets an inside edge that goes past the stumps away from the keeper for a boundary,
Angles it into middle and leg. Tad shorter in length and Verma works it towards the leg side.
Ellyse Perry comes into the attack now and bowls it back of a length and around off. Verma dabs it towards the off side.

In the air...but well away from the fielders! Back of a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. She does not get the middle of her blade and the ball goes high in the air and falls short of the ropes where the fielder cuts it off. She throws it back to the non-striker's end and Shafali Verma just about completes the second run. The replays confirm the same.
A length delivery that is angled across the left-hander. Smriti Mandhana tries to dab it away towards the off side but misses.
FOUR! Elegance personified! Just short of good length and around off. Smriti Mandhana rides the bounce and just punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a good length and it nips back in from middle. Smriti Mandhana tries to clip it but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Beaten! Back of a length and around off. Smriti Mandhana walks down the track and looks to heave it towards the leg side but misses.
Just short of good length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana works it to square leg.
Kim Garth to start from the other end.
SIX! BANG! Shafali Verma looks in mood today! Back of a length, on off. Verma stands tall and pulls it all the way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Back of a length and around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it to sweeper cover for a single. She is off the mark as well.
Bowls it fuller but on middle stump line this time. Verma drills it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Here we go... Shafali Verma and India Women are underway in style! A fullish delivery, around off. Verma reaches the pitch of the ball and slams it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length and around off. Verma punches it to covers this time.
Megan Schutt starts with a big inswinger! It starts from outside off and shapes in nicely into the batter. Verma tries to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.

We are moments away from the start of this game! The anthems are done and the Indian opening pair of Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana stride onto the middle now. The Australian players are already in the middle and we are all set for a cracking contest. Megan Schutt to start with the ball. Here we go...
Time for the national anthems now! We will have Australia's national anthem first followed by the Indian national anthem.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says that they wanted to bowl first because it is a first game. Tells that Anjali Sarvani is a slow medium pacer and tells that she has been great in the domestic structure and she has lot of experience behind her. Tells that they have lot of variety in both batting and bowling and they have done well in recent times and they are looking to do well in this game.

Alyssa Healy, the skipper of Australia Women says that they are going to bowl first and adds that they have not played in this venue before. Hopes they can stuck into the strong Indian batting line-up and she is hoping for a great series. Tells that they are excited to have Kim Garth in the team and they are alll behind her.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (C) (WK), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Grace Harris, Annabel Sutherland, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Kim Garth (On debut), Megan Schutt.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Devika Vaidya, Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Anjali Sarvani (On debut), Meghna Singh, Renuka Singh.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Australia Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

Australia Women don't have the services of regular skipper Meg Lanning for this series and it will be their charismatic opener, Alyssa Healy who will lead the team. Most of the players on the visiting team were a part of the recently concluded WBBL which means that they would be match fit as well. The Aussies can threaten any side no matter if they play at home or away and it will be interesting to see which side can make better use of the conditions on offer. Will the Women in Blue start off with a win? Or will the Aussies flex their muscles? We shall find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

India Women are back at home and they face a stiff challenge from the mighty Aussies as both teams look to get into the gears in the lead-up to the 2023 ICC Women's T20 World Cup. The hosts had a great campaign in this year's Asia Cup as they emerged as champions and will look to continue in the same fashion here as well. Skipper Harmanpreet Kaur will look to get ahead in the series but it won't be an easy task.

Hello and a warm welcome ladies and gentlemen to the 1st T20I between India Women and Australia Women from the DY Patil stadium in Navi Mumbai. The five-match T20I series between these two white-ball powerhouses gets underway and neither team would be looking to back down from the challenge in front of them.
... MATCH DAY …

It is time for the first T20I of the five-match series of Australia Women's tour of India, in 2022. Indians dominated during the recent Asia Cup, winning the tournament, as they completely outplayed Sri Lanka Women's in the finals. They shall carry confidence in this series as well. The Australians have an impressive record against India Women in the past. The side has won the last five games between the two teams and will look to build on this record. Alyssa Healy replaces Meg Lanning as the skipper of the side in this series. The majority of their players had solid performances throughout the WBBL and will want to maintain that form. Beth Mooney, Alyssa Healy, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, and Rachael Haynes at the start will look to put as much score on the board and build good partnerships. On the bowling front, the side would look for tight spells from Darcie Brown and Megan Schutt at the start of the game. Jess Jonassen will look to get her lines in the middle overs alongside Alana King and McGrath. Harmanpreet Kaur's side takes on its most formidable competitor in this game, and they will look for a good start here. They have had an amazing Asia cup and will look to continue with the same. Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, and Kaur did well in the Asia Cup, and then they shall look to set up a big partnership at the start. The Indian bowling attack would be up against the best in the world. The side would need good spells from Deepti Sharma and Renuka Singh with the new ball. Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Radha Yadav need to do well in the middle overs. Indians are tough to beat at home as the conditions favor their style of play. Let's hope for an interesting contest.
